narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A square has its own special name, so it belongs to no other family.
<bookmark mark='card'/>A family name comes from a definition, not from how special a shape looks.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>If the square meets a definition, it earns that name as well.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Test a shape against each definition, and keep every family name that fits.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Which other family names does a rhombus carry? Test it against each definition in turn.
